scope: All scheduled definition bodies, theorem preamble+statement files and top-level solution files. No source or candidate manifest changed. Staged byte hashes match the active import manifests.
method: Recompiled exact scheduled payload files in isolated copies with package leanOptions autoImplicit=false. Checked every module setup JSON records autoImplicit=false and every compiled artifact exists. Requested independent module targets, because separate solutions deliberately declare the same top-level solution identifier and cannot be jointly imported into one root module.
harness_deviation: Initial aggregate StrictCheck root failed only because it imported multiple distinct top-level solution declarations. All57 actual payload modules compiled successfully before that aggregate failure. The final invocation targets modules independently and exits0.
limitations: Expected sorry warnings arise only in theorem statement stubs. This local elaboration check is distinct from the server acceptance/axiom check. Hosted runtime uses the existing executable-location compatibility launcher.
